name: Art Gallery
description: Everyone draws the same prompt, the teacher previews the gallery, then the drawings reveal one at a time on the projector — the template for any draw-and-share moment.

intro.message:
🎨 ART GALLERY!

You'll get one prompt and 90 seconds to draw it on your device. No erasing your neighbor's masterpiece — everyone's goes up on the wall.

draw.prompt: Draw your dream invention — something the world needs but nobody has built yet.

check.template: Review the drawings below, then open the gallery.

end.message: 🎨 That's the Art Gallery! Swap in your own drawing prompt for any topic.
